object_description: two four-storey volumes enclosing a covered courtyard, with the sports field lifted onto the roof
geometry_property: horizontally and vertically structured element facade
design_condition: the two volumes are placed to enclose the courtyard between them as a neighbourhood foyer and to open a generous connecting space between the footbridge and the square, with the sports field stacked on the roof

positive: Two cleverly placed volumes enclose the courtyard between them as a neighbourhood foyer
A generously proportioned connecting space is created between the footbridge and the square
The sports field on the second floor forms a school roof so that the schoolyard becomes a spatially covered neighbourhood foyer
The area is given a new address full of character
Both buildings are simple volumes with only small projections serving the kindergarten outdoor area and supporting the sports field
The urban design is convincingly successful and creates the necessary address plus an attractive outdoor space for the neighbourhood
The footbridge of prefabricated concrete elements is simply and pragmatically designed
The exterior design impresses with its simplicity
The architectural language is precisely chosen and references the industrial history of the site
Footbridge and overhanging roof are convincingly interwoven with the structured concrete element facade into a design whole
Thanks to its efficient organisation the proposal is also convincing economically
The open break area creates the urgently needed opening for the area and a usable outdoor space for the whole neighbourhood
negative: The covered outdoor space is not optimally lit
The arrangement of the stairwells on the facades appears somewhat cramped and in places intersects the outdoor access areas
The connections between the outdoor break areas on the upper floors are not yet convincingly designed and still appear forced
